name: eight-hour-block-hourly-spacing-band-015
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis (15th consecutive negative static-mix run). 2026-10-10 found that narrowing allocation_threshold from 0.1 to 0.04 under the 8h-block / 1h-spacing throttle added 15 drift-correction trades @500k and worsened the static-mix deficit (-0.72 vs -0.35), i.e. intra-block drift corrections cost more than they earn. Lead #3 of that report: widen the band to 0.15 to test whether the remaining drift corrections are also net costly. At 50,000 JPY any band below ~0.25 is inert, so the primary verdict is not evidence about the band; the diagnostic capitals are.
